output.reason: The linked PR [ev-c7ca6ba37e4a] says this change adds the Brotli compression algorithm to Traefik. It carries the "breaking" label and says that a request with `Accept-Encoding: *` now gets a compressed (Brotli) response where it used to get an uncompressed one. [ev-1e73c4689517] adds that when the header is present but empty, compression is disabled. The changed files [ev-efb242390d83] (docs/content/middlewares/http/compress.md, pkg/middlewares/compress/*, pkg/config/dynamic/middlewares.go) show the subject is the HTTP Compress middleware, so the subject and applicability can be written: setups using the compress middleware, with clients sending a wildcard or empty Accept-Encoding header. Both proposals cited only the one-line changelog [ev-ae9158566d1b] and missed this breaking behaviour change; the PR text about a missing Accept-Encoding header is cut off, so that one detail is incomplete.
